source_caption:
Lindsay Lohan and Jamie Lee Curtis rehearsed extensively for Freaky Friday to mimic each other’s mannerisms, so that after the body swap their performances would feel believable—down to small gestures, posture, and speech patterns.

Freaky Friday (2003), directed by Mark Waters, starring Lindsay Lohan, Jamie Lee Curtis, Chad Michael Murray. A fun and heartfelt comedy about a mother and daughter who magically switch bodies, learning empathy, perspective, and the challenges of each other’s lives.

source_details.title: Freaky Friday
source_details.synopsis: Freaky Friday is a 2003 American fantasy comedy film directed by Mark Waters and written by Heather Hach and Leslie Dixon. It is based on the 1972 novel by Mary Rodgers and marks the third film adaptation of the novel, as well as the third installment overall in the Freaky Friday franchise. The film stars Jamie Lee Curtis and Lindsay Lohan as a mother and daughter who inadvertently switch bodies through the magic of Chinese fortune cookies. The supporting cast includes Harold Gould, Chad Michael Murray, and Mark Harmon. Freaky Friday was released theatrically by Walt Disney Pictures on August 6, 2003.
